tutorials.title: Build Connected Manufacturing Solutions with Oracle AI Database
tutorials.description: The SEER MANUFACTURING intelligence story and workshop goals.

tutorials.title: Getting Started
tutorials.description: Launch the environment and open Database Actions SQL Worksheet.

tutorials.title: Lab 1: Build a Converged Dashboard Query
tutorials.description: Use a converged query to connect component quality issues, production orders, semantic matches, and production coverage.

tutorials.title: Lab 2: Build a JSON Application Model
tutorials.description: Help Thomas choose between JSON columns, JSON collections, and JSON Relational Duality for a production application.

tutorials.title: Lab 3: Search Components by Meaning
tutorials.description: Review how Gilly built semantic search with an in-database embedding model for components and production-quality notices.

tutorials.title: Lab 4: Trace a Production Quality Network
tutorials.description: Review Bob's graph approach to finding production orders linked by shared traceability records with Oracle Property Graph and SQL/PGQ.

tutorials.title: Lab 5: Find the Closest Manufacturing Plant
tutorials.description: Use Oracle Spatial for plant and manufacturing-region analysis.

tutorials.title: Lab 6: Build a Quality Review Watchlist with Oracle Machine Learning
tutorials.description: Train and score a component quality-review model inside Oracle Database.

tutorials.title: Lab 7: Ask Manufacturing Questions with Select AI
tutorials.description: Use Select AI to turn natural-language manufacturing questions into SQL you can inspect and run.

tutorials.title: Lab 8: Build a Manufacturing Agent with Select AI Agent
tutorials.description: Create a manufacturing agent instructed to use an approved SQL tool for read-only questions.

tutorials.title: Lab 9: Final Quiz
tutorials.description: Check your understanding with scored questions.

tutorials.title: Need Help?
tutorials.description: Solutions to common problems and directions for receiving Live Help.
